purpose.summary: Checkout-scoped verification harness for the canonical readout keystone (dafa2978). The 2026-09-12 chain receipt recorded the keystone's internal fields as UNVERIFIED; this wave installs the instrument that can honestly move them to VERIFIED when CI checks out main, and honestly keeps them UNVERIFIED while anchors are absent.
purpose.principle: Report-only by design: the suite fails only on its own inconsistency, never on keystone structure it cannot predict. Dispositions are VERIFIED or UNAVAILABLE per requirement with evidence strings.

relationToLane.rule: Exists to close the keystone's UNVERIFIED window without guessing its bytes; verifies against the semantic checklist taught by the Codex-reviewed superseded wave.

claimSurfaces: The harness asserts structure, not correctness of claims; a VERIFIED requirement means the anchor language is present in the canonical record.
Until a CI run reports 7-of-7 VERIFIED, every estate organ remains MODELED or NO_ORGAN and the keystone internals remain UNVERIFIED.
This record is preparation, not measurement, not deployment, not qualification.
